title: SiteDrift
tagline: The open-source browser extension to bypass redirects and tracking
overview: SiteDrift is a privacy-focused browser extension and backend service that helps users bypass redirect links, wait timers, and trackers. It combines a premium, 'hacker-chic' SPA frontend with a high-performance Go backend and Crowd Bypass server to provide a seamless browsing experience across Chrome, Edge, and Firefox.
problem: Navigating the web often involves annoying redirect links, forced wait timers, and pervasive tracking that degrade the user experience and compromise privacy.
solution: SiteDrift offers a multi-browser extension backed by a unified monorepo infrastructure. It intercepts and bypasses tracking redirects instantly, utilizing a crowdsourced backend (Crowd Bypass) to skip forced wait times.
